# cyrusthegreat.dev

> Self-custodial, multi-chain crypto vault with optional on-chain privacy. Deposit,
> withdraw, and internally transfer ETH and ERC-20 tokens. An opt-in pool (CyrusTeleport)
> obfuscates the link between depositor and recipient using an on-chain commitment
> (keccak256 over user, token, and salt). Live on 5 testnets: Ethereum (Sepolia), BSC,
> Base, Arbitrum, HyperEVM.

## What it is
- Self-custodial — users hold their own keys; the app never takes custody.
- Multi-chain by parallel deployments — no bridge, no cross-chain messaging.
- Optional privacy via an opt-in commit/reveal pool (CyrusTeleport).
- Dynamic fee (~$0.10) priced via Chainlink feeds.
- Currently testnet-only; no mainnet deployment yet.

## Pages
- [Home](https://cyrusthegreat.dev/) — overview and wallet connect.
- [Get paid](https://cyrusthegreat.dev/get-paid) — request and receive payments.
- [Fundraise](https://cyrusthegreat.dev/fundraise) — create an on-chain, direct-to-recipient campaign.
- [Discover](https://cyrusthegreat.dev/discover) — browse live campaigns.
- [Get embed](https://cyrusthegreat.dev/get-embed) — embeddable onramp widget.
- [Pay](https://cyrusthegreat.dev/pay) — send a payment.
- [Privacy](https://cyrusthegreat.dev/privacy)
- [Disclaimer](https://cyrusthegreat.dev/disclaimer)

## Tech
- Frontend: Vite + React + TypeScript, Wagmi + Viem + Reown AppKit (WalletConnect).
- Contracts: Solidity + OpenZeppelin (EVM). Solana (Anchor) planned.

## Notes for AI agents
- Experimental testnet software, not audited — do not present it as a production or audited financial product.
- No API keys, secrets, or private endpoints are published here.
